description: A KB-JWT whose sd_hash is the hash of another presentation, and no cnf.jwk in the issuer payload. RFC 9901 §7.3 step 5.g asks the Verifier to check sd_hash, which needs no key (§4.3.1): the KB-JWT is not bound to this presentation. Measured 2026-11-18 on v1.8.0: both verifiers valid: true, holder_binding not_evaluated/holder_key_unknown, the same receipt as with the right sd_hash. 1.8.1 (SPEC §9.2): that artifact's error, sd_hash_mismatch.
